payload.core_mechanism_summary: Simulates two possible alternating sequences of operations starting with either operation 1 or 2, effectively performing a graph search along a deterministic path until sorted or cycle detected.
payload.rationale: The code tries both initial moves and alternates operations until the array is sorted or returns to the start, which is a limited form of state space exploration akin to DFS/BFS without queue. Chosen from complete_search family as the closest match despite no explicit graph structures.
